'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Pierre Dubreuil DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Pierre Dubreuil]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Spice a la Reid Smith. Pierre Dubreuil / BRINGHIMB4ME, WORLDS 2014 TO, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' BRINGHIMB4ME
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
